similar_in_english: not the sharpest tool in the shed
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে এত মাথামোটা যে সহজ কথাও বুঝতে পারে না।
মাথামোটা লোকের সাথে কথা বলা বৃথা।
example_sentences_in_english: He's so thick-headed that he can't understand even simple things.
It's futile to talk with such a dull-witted person.
note: This idiom draws from the cultural notion of 'ghiu' (clarified butter) symbolizing brain matter or intelligence in traditional Bengali expressions.
